name: CommandPalette
summary: The command palette with the engine wired up: type, filter, run.

props.name: open
props.description: REQUIRED. You own the state, as in Dialog and Drawer. Closed, it renders nothing at all.

props.name: onClose
props.description: REQUIRED. Fires on Escape and after a command is chosen — in that order: closing happens BEFORE the command runs, so a command that navigates does not leave the palette floating over the new screen.

props.name: items
props.description: REQUIRED. Commands as DATA ({id, label, icon?, kbd?, run}), never children — a list kept as children drifts out of sync with the filter, which is the same decision Combobox took.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Also the accessible name of the input.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: The line under the list that teaches the keys: ↑ ↓ move, Enter open, Esc close. Each item may also say its group (item.group): items of the same group come together under its title.

props.name: size
props.description: lg is the large search: a window as wide as --breakpoint-lg (1024), a 64 field (the magnifier, 18 letters and Esc inside), group titles in uppercase code font with their count, 50 items with the icon in a 40 circle, the title and a cut description, and ↵ on the active row.

props.name: items[].description / items[].tone
props.description: With lg: the second line of the item (muted, cut), and the category color of its icon circle (the Badge colors); without tone, the circle is neutral.

props.name: filters
props.description: With lg: what goes under the field — the filters the app draws (a ToggleGroup, for example).

props.name: preview
props.description: With lg: the preview of the active item, beside the list, on --fill-1 with radius 22. It goes when the window is under 1240 wide.

props.name: footer
props.description: With lg: what goes in the foot, next to the key hints.
